name: material_define
description: Create a material, or fully replace an existing one with the same id (upsert, FULL REPLACE: omitted optional fields are cleared and roughness resets to 0.9, so send every field you want to keep). A material kind ("paint" or "texture") can never change; use a new id for a different kind. For a library texture use kind "texture" with textureUrl "lib:<slug>" (slugs: materials://list). Define a material before using it in a finish.

id.description: Material id (1-64 characters), unique across all entities. Reference it from finishes and defaults.

kind.description: "paint" is a flat colour; "texture" adds a PBR texture set (needs textureUrl). Cannot change once defined.

color.description: Base colour as #rrggbb. For textures it is the fallback and tint colour.

roughness.description: Surface roughness from 0 (mirror) to 1 (matte). Defaults to 0.9.

textureUrl.description: Texture set as "lib:<slug>"; read materials://list for the available slugs. Required when kind is "texture".

textureScale.description: Size in metres of one texture tile. Optional.

material.description: The complete material. An existing id is fully replaced (omitted optional fields are cleared); kind cannot change.

name: material_remove
description: Delete a material. Fails with precondition_failed (naming the users) while a wall, a room (floor, ceiling or wall finish) or a default still uses it; reassign those first.

id.description: Id of the material to delete. Fails with precondition_failed while any wall, room or default uses it.

name: wall_set_finish
description: Paint one or both faces of a wall. Pass roomId (strongly recommended) to paint only that room's stretch of the face: the alcove and the sejour can share a wall and get different colours. Without roomId the whole face is painted for every room on it. Precedence on a stretch of face, most specific first: the room-scoped finish (roomId), the whole-face finish, the room's paint-all-walls (room_set_wall_finish), the scene default. Left and right follow the walking direction from wall start to end on the plan (plan y grows down). materialId null clears the finish.

wallId.description: Id of the wall (walls[].id from get_scene_summary).

side.description: Which face of the wall. "left" is the left of someone walking from the wall start to its end on the plan (plan y grows down; see wallLeftNormal), "right" the other face, "both" both faces. With roomId, "both" means every face of this wall that the room adjoins.

materialId.description: Id of a defined material (materials[].id in get_scene_summary), or null to clear back to the default. To use a library texture first call material.define with textureUrl "lib:<slug>" (slugs: materials://list).

roomId.description: The room whose stretch of this wall side to paint (from list_rooms or describe_room). Strongly recommended: a wall side can be shared by several rooms (e.g. the alcove and the sejour) and without roomId the whole side is painted for all of them. Fails with precondition_failed if the room does not border that side. A room-scoped finish beats the whole-side finish and room.setWallFinish.

name: wall_set_structural
description: Mark a wall structural (never removable) or removable, or clear the mark. Walls that are exterior or at least 15 cm thick are structural by default; only a user may mark such a wall removable (an LLM gets precondition_failed).

wallId.description: Id of the wall (walls[].id from get_scene_summary).

structural.description: true marks the wall structural (cannot be removed); false marks it removable; null clears the explicit mark so it is derived (exterior or at least 15 cm thick means structural). Only a user may set false on a wall that is structural by default.

name: room_set_wall_finish
description: Paint all the walls of a room with one material (the room's own stretches only: neighbouring rooms keep their look, even on shared wall faces). It replaces any earlier per-wall paint of that room; a later wall_set_finish on one of its walls wins again. materialId null removes the room paint. Fails with no_wall_sides when none of the room's edges run along a wall face (an unwalled room).

roomId.description: Id of the room (from list_rooms or get_scene_summary).

materialId.description: Id of a defined material (materials[].id in get_scene_summary), or null to clear back to the default. To use a library texture first call material.define with textureUrl "lib:<slug>" (slugs: materials://list).

name: room_set_floor
description: Set the floor material of a room (null clears it so the scene default applies).

roomId.description: Id of the room (from list_rooms or get_scene_summary).

materialId.description: Id of a defined material (materials[].id in get_scene_summary), or null to clear back to the default. To use a library texture first call material.define with textureUrl "lib:<slug>" (slugs: materials://list).

name: room_set_ceiling
description: Set the ceiling material of a room (null clears it so the scene default applies).

roomId.description: Id of the room (from list_rooms or get_scene_summary).

materialId.description: Id of a defined material (materials[].id in get_scene_summary), or null to clear back to the default. To use a library texture first call material.define with textureUrl "lib:<slug>" (slugs: materials://list).

name: scene_set_defaults
description: Set the scene-wide default materials used where a wall face, floor or ceiling has none. Omitted fields stay unchanged; null clears one.

wall.description: Default wall material for faces without a finish. Omit to leave unchanged, null to clear.

floor.description: Default floor material. Omit to leave unchanged, null to clear.

ceiling.description: Default ceiling material. Omit to leave unchanged, null to clear.

name: site_set
description: Change site fields (location, orientation, time zone, floor elevation, address). Omitted fields stay unchanged; address null clears it.

northAngle.description: Clockwise angle in degrees from plan "up" (-y) to true north.

floorElevation.description: Height of the flat floor above street level, in metres.

address.description: Postal address (at most 300 characters); null clears it.

site.description: Fields to change; omitted fields stay as they are.

name: light_add
description: Add a light (point, spot or area). The id is derived (light-N) when omitted.

id.description: Optional light id; derived as "light-N" when omitted.

roomId.description: Room the light belongs to (from list_rooms). Optional.

position.description: Plan position [x, y] in metres; plan y grows down the page.

elevation.description: Height of the light source above the floor, in metres.

lumens.description: Luminous flux in lumens (a 60 W-equivalent bulb is about 800).

kelvin.description: Colour temperature in kelvin, 1000-12000 (2700 warm, 6500 daylight). Defaults to 2700.

on.description: Whether the light is switched on. Defaults to true.

type.description: A point light radiates in all directions. Discriminator: "point".

id.description: Optional light id; derived as "light-N" when omitted.

roomId.description: Room the light belongs to (from list_rooms). Optional.

position.description: Plan position [x, y] in metres; plan y grows down the page.

elevation.description: Height of the light source above the floor, in metres.

kelvin.description: Colour temperature in kelvin, 1000-12000 (2700 warm, 6500 daylight). Defaults to 2700.

on.description: Whether the light is switched on. Defaults to true.

type.description: A spot light shines straight down in a cone. Discriminator: "spot".

angle.description: Spot cone angle in degrees (1-179). Defaults to 60.

id.description: Optional light id; derived as "light-N" when omitted.

roomId.description: Room the light belongs to (from list_rooms). Optional.

position.description: Plan position [x, y] in metres; plan y grows down the page.

elevation.description: Height of the light source above the floor, in metres.

kelvin.description: Colour temperature in kelvin, 1000-12000 (2700 warm, 6500 daylight). Defaults to 2700.

on.description: Whether the light is switched on. Defaults to true.

type.description: A rectangular panel facing down. Discriminator: "area".

width.description: Panel width in metres along plan x before rotation.

depth.description: Panel depth in metres along plan y before rotation.

rotation.description: Panel rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise seen from above. Defaults to 0.

light.description: The light to add: point, spot or area, discriminated by its "type".

name: light_update
description: Change fields of an existing light. Omitted fields stay unchanged; name and roomId accept null to clear. A light cannot take fields of another light type.

id.description: Id of the light (lights[].id from get_scene_summary).

name.description: Label (at most 120 characters); null clears it.

roomId.description: Room the light belongs to (from list_rooms); null clears it.

position.description: Plan position [x, y] in metres; plan y grows down the page.

elevation.description: Height of the light source above the floor, in metres.

on.description: Whether the light is switched on.

angle.description: Spot lights only: cone angle in degrees (1-179).

width.description: Area lights only: width in metres.

depth.description: Area lights only: depth in metres.

rotation.description: Area lights only: rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise seen from above.

patch.description: Fields to change; omitted fields stay as they are, null clears name and roomId. A light cannot take fields of another light type.

name: light_remove
description: Remove a light by id. Undo restores it at the same position in the list.

id.description: Id of the light to remove.

name: batch
description: Apply several commands atomically as one undo step: if any fails nothing is applied and the error path says which (commands/N/...). Prefer it for multi-step edits. At most 500 commands; batches cannot nest.

label.description: Short description of the whole change, shown in the undo history (at most 200 characters).

commands.description: Commands applied in order and atomically: all succeed or none apply. At most 500; batches cannot nest.
